name: Scholar
description: Scientists, researchers, and physicians who pursue knowledge and healing.

assignments.name: Field Researcher
assignments.description: You are an explorer or field scientist who investigates natural phenomena first-hand.

assignments.name: Scientist
assignments.description: You work in a laboratory or research institution.

assignments.name: Physician
assignments.description: You are a doctor or medical researcher.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: Your work is sabotaged by unknown parties. You may salvage what you can and try to continue. Roll Investigate 8+ to identify who sabotaged your work.
events.effectDescription: Roll Investigate 8+. Succeed: gain a Rival. Fail: lose a Benefit roll.

effects.detail: Investigate 8+ to identify saboteur or lose Benefit

events.description: You make a breakthrough in your field.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: A rival researcher steals some of your work. Gain a Rival.
events.effectDescription: Gain a Rival. Gain one level in any skill.

effects.detail: Gain one level in any skill

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You have the opportunity to cheat in some fashion, advancing your career and research by making claims about data that are simply not true.
events.effectDescription: If you refuse, gain nothing. If you accept, gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll but also gain a Rival.

events.description: You make a breakthrough in your field.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: You are entrusted with a secret project by a patron or organisation.
events.effectDescription: Gain a Contact and an extra Benefit roll.

events.description: Your work leads to a considerable breakthrough.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: Your work is revolutionary, changing the course of your field.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: A disaster leaves several colleagues dead. You are blamed for it. Gain D3 Enemies.

The planetary government interferes with your research for political or religious reasons. If you continue with your work openly, gain an Enemy. If you continue secretly, roll Deception 8+. Fail: gain an Enemy.
mishaps.effectDescription: Continue openly: Enemy. Continue secretly: Deception 8+ or Enemy.

mishaps.description: An expedition or field research goes wrong, leaving you stranded in the wilderness. Gain Survival 1.
Your work is sabotaged by unknown parties. You may salvage what you can and try to continue.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
